name: uptick-scope-check
description: Compare client requests with agreed scope and draft evidence-backed change orders and client replies.

interface.longDescription:
Compare a client request with an agreed statement of work and approved amendments. Identify included work, corrections, additions, and unclear obligations with source citations. Prepare a proposed change order and a respectful client reply.

For agencies, consultants, and service teams. Pricing uses supplied quantities and rates; a bundled Python helper checks decimal arithmetic when execution is available. It does not estimate missing effort, promise delivery dates, send messages, or approve charges. Operational guidance, not a legal opinion.

No Uptick account or API key is needed. Provide the relevant documents through your AI tool; the plugin does not send them to Uptick.
defaultPrompt: Compare this client request with our agreed scope. Draft a change order and reply.
Is this a defect, an included revision, or extra work? Show the supporting clauses.
